age.evidence: The inclusion criteria for participants in this study were (1) age <60 days, (2) DBIL ≥34.2 μmol/L, and (3) direct bilirubin/total bilirubin (DBIL/TBIL) ≥20%.

developmental_stage.evidence: In total, 154 cases of infant cholestasis were collected from inpatient and outpatient first visits at Guangzhou Women and Children’s Medical Center (China) during 2018–2020, of which 81 patients with BA and 71 patients with IHC were finally diagnosed.
